name: giant_pacific_octopus
description: Giant Pacific octopus seen from slightly above, arms spread wide: deep red-orange #c8452f wrinkled mantle in the upper centre (top y -284), head with two raised eyes with horizontal-slit pupils, paler mottled webbing, eight curling arms with darker tops, pale undersides and white suckers; the two outer arms reach the full width (tips x -500..+500). The beak area at (0,+20) is hidden under the head. Anchor centre, ~1000x575 (y -284..+290).
